title: 第十七章 只有状元徒弟没有状元师父第十章 此时无声胜有声
slug: 民国戏子请叫我武道宗师
content_zh:
“嗡！”
枪杆震颤。
陆诚手腕一抖。
枪尖如同毒蛇吐信，瞬间点出三朵枪花。
这枪花不是虚的，每一朵都带着撕裂空气的锐啸声。
啪！啪！啪！
三声脆响，连成一线。
空中正在飘落的几片鹅毛大雪，竟然被这极速抖动的枪尖，精准地挑中。
雪花没有碎。
而是像被一股子柔和的内劲吸附在枪尖上一样，随着枪身的旋转而旋转。
这叫“黏劲”。
是内家拳练到精深处，刚柔并济的表现。
若是只有刚劲，这雪花早就成了水气。
若是只有柔劲，这枪尖也破不开风雪。
“好一个赵子龙。”
陆诚只觉得体内气血奔涌，那股子被压在骨髓里的力量，正在疯狂地往外冒。
他能清晰地感觉到。
自己的脊椎骨，正在发热，发烫。
每一个骨节都在律动，像是一条蛟蟒在他背后苏醒。
【虎豹雷音】不仅仅是在练脏腑，更是在通过这种高频率的震动，打磨他的筋骨。

那层隔在“整劲”和“明劲”之间的窗户纸。
在这一刻，变得无比稀薄。
只差一点点。
只差那临门一脚，就能把这一身的劲力，练得通透光明，炸裂如雷。
“吼……”
陆诚胸腔震动，雷音在寂静的小院里回荡。
手中的大枪越来越快，最后竟然看不见枪身，只能看见一团白光将他整个人包裹在其中。
风雪不得进！
那些飘落的雪花，在靠近他身体三尺范围时，就被那股子枪风激荡开来，形成了一个真空的圆。
这若是让懂枪的武师看见，非得赞一声不可。
这叫“泼水不进”！
是枪法入了行的。
……
后台的门缝里。
一双乌溜溜的眼睛，正死死地盯着院子里的这一幕。
是那个叫小豆子的小徒弟。
他本来是起夜撒尿，听见动静，忍不住好奇偷偷看了一眼。
这一看，他就挪不动步了。
他虽然不懂什么明劲暗劲，但他看得懂什么是“美”，什么是“强”。
那个在雪地里舞枪的身影，太好看了。

那枪尖上挑着的不是雪花，是星光啊！
小豆子只觉得心跳得咚咚响，浑身的血都在往脑门上涌。
以前，他觉得练功苦。
每天早起喊嗓子，撕腿，拿大顶，挨师父的藤条。
content_en:
"Buzz!"
The barrel of the gun trembled.
Lu Cheng flicked his wrist.
The tip of the spear was like a poisonous snake spitting out a message, instantly lighting up three spear flowers.
These gun flowers are not empty, each one has a sharp whistle that tears the air.
Snap! Snap! Snap!
Three crisp sounds, connected in a line.
A few large pieces of snow falling in the sky were accurately picked up by the tip of the rapidly shaking spear.
The snowflakes did not break.
Instead, it is as if it is attracted to the tip of the gun by a soft inner force, rotating as the gun body rotates.
This is called "stickiness".
It is a manifestation of the internal martial arts practiced to a deep level, combining hardness and softness.
If it had only strength, this snowflake would have turned into water vapor long ago.
If it had only soft strength, the tip of the spear would not be able to break through the wind and snow.
"What a great Zhao Zilong."
Lu Cheng only felt that the energy and blood in his body were rushing, and the power that had been suppressed in his bone marrow was leaking out crazily.
He could feel it clearly.
My spine is heating up.
Every joint was beating, like a python waking up behind him.
[Tiger Leopard Thunder Sound] is not only training the internal organs, but also polishing his muscles and bones through this high-frequency vibration.
That layer of window paper between "Zheng Jin" and "Ming Jin".
At this moment, it becomes extremely thin.
Just a little bit.
It only takes one final kick to train the strength of this body to become transparent and bright, and explode like thunder.
"Roar..."
Lu Cheng's chest vibrated, and the sound of thunder echoed in the quiet courtyard.
The big gun in his hand went faster and faster, and finally the gun body could not be seen, only a ball of white light could be seen enveloping his whole body.
No entry in the wind or snow!
When the falling snowflakes came within three feet of his body, they were stirred up by the gun wind and formed a vacuum circle.
If a martial artist who knows how to use guns saw this, he would definitely praise it.
This is called "splashing water but not getting in"!
He is good at marksmanship.
…
In the crack of the door backstage.
A pair of dark eyes were staring at the scene in the yard.
It's the little apprentice named Xiaodouzi.
He had gotten up at night to urinate, and when he heard the noise, he couldn't help but take a peek out of curiosity.
At this sight, he could no longer move.
Although he doesn't understand what bright strength and dark strength are, he can understand what "beauty" is and what "strength" is.
That figure dancing with a gun in the snow is so beautiful.
What's on the tip of the gun is not snowflakes, but starlight!
Xiaodouzi felt his heart pounding loudly, and all the blood in his body was rushing to his forehead.
In the past, he felt that practicing Kung Fu was hard.
Get up early every day to shout, tear your legs, hold a big top, and hit the master's cane.
